subject: CueFlow + Redwood SDK: sprint invite & compatibility checklist
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha@emberworks.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@emberworks.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: CueFlow + Redwood SDK: request to align on tracing + compatibility

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — EmberWorks is excited about the latency profile and the cache semantics you showed. We're getting ready for a customer-facing integration of our prompt orchestration product CueFlow and want to make sure the integration with Redwood's SDK and tracing hooks is production-ready.

High-level asks: 
- A compatibility matrix for SDK calls we currently use (init, sendBatch, streaming hooks, functionCalling)
- Guidance on how to attach distributed tracing and token-level attribution to requests so we can show auditability to our customers
- A short mutual action plan and rough SOW for a 2-week technical sprint (sandbox -> acceptance)

I've attached a first-pass compat matrix (compat_matrix_v1.xlsx) and a draft SOW (sow_draft_emberworks.pdf). Can we schedule a kickoff this week? We're aiming for sprint work in the week of Apr 9.

Thanks,
Aisha
Product Partnerships | EmberWorks Inc.
phone: +1 (415) 555-0198
attachments: compat_matrix_v1.xlsx, sow_draft_emberworks.pdf
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@emberworks.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CueFlow + Redwood SDK: request to align on tracing + compatibility

Hi Aisha — really appreciate the materials and the clear asks. I'm copying Kim (SDK PM) and Marissa (Partner Ops) so we can scope the sprint and call out procurement steps.

Quick replies to your bullets: 
- We'll produce a compatibility matrix mapping CueFlow patterns to our SDK surface (including streaming and function calling). Expect that by EOD Wed.
- For tracing/token attribution: we have two recommended approaches — (1) SDK-level trace hooks that emit Zipkin/OpenTelemetry spans and attach a request_token_id to each call, and (2) an attribution header pattern (X-Redwood-Attribution) for downstream logging. We'll include example snippets and an acceptance test harness.
- Sprint proposal: 10 days, split dev (5d) + validation (3d) + buffer/rollover (2d). We can run this against a Redwood-hosted sandbox and a customer-mirroring private deployment if you need pinning.

Proposed kickoff times (PST): Wed 4/3 10:00-10:45, Thu 4/4 13:00-13:45. Which works?

I'll attach the draft runbook after Kim and I sync on the tech checklist.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Partner Solutions | Redwood Inference

Thanks Aisha — this aligns with what I've seen from other ISV partners. A few clarifying items before kickoff: 

1) Acceptance criteria: please confirm the top 3 acceptance tests you care about (we recommend: streaming correctness under 200ms tail latency, trace span correlation for cross-service flows, and token attribution present on 100% of logged requests).
2) Data/PII: if CueFlow will send user-provided PII as part of prompts, we'll need the data handling steps documented and an optional VPC-only run if required by your customers.
3) Licensing/SOW: Marissa, can you share the standard 2-week SOW template and a marketplace discount if EmberWorks will resell Redwood?

Aisha — FYI: we can support Otel spans and will provide a short code snippet for SDK initialization to opt into attribution headers. Also attaching a link to a short example runbook in Drive.

Thanks Kim — acceptance criteria confirmed. We'll aim for: 
- streaming correctness under 200ms tail latency (we'll provide sample load profile)
- trace span correlation for request -> CueFlow -> Redwood -> downstream logs
- token attribution header included and surfaced in logs and audit exports

On PII: CueFlow will never persist PII in the product; prompts may contain identifiers depending on customer configuration. We can document the handling steps and opt for VPC-only runs for regulated customers.

On SOW/licensing: yes please, Marissa — we'd like any reseller terms and a partner discount for marketplace listing.

We're good to take Wed 4/3 10:00 PST for kickoff. I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Best,
Aisha
